claims.name: models-resolved-at-the-source
claims.risk: an alias on /v2/chat still reaches the provider as a model id (404), or a default, a model id or the old route stopped answering 200 with the right model

claims.name: client-errors-not-retried

claims.name: waits-as-the-provider-asks
claims.risk: after a 429 the route calls again sooner than the provider asked, or a burst over the shared key's quota does not end in 200s

claims.name: no-blanket-delay

claims.name: unit-tests-pass

claims.name: limits-not-widened

claims.name: provider-stand-in-unchanged
